title: AlphaEval: A Comprehensive and Efficient Evaluation Framework for Formula Alpha Mining

problem.claim: Systematically evaluating predictive signals generated by formula alpha mining is challenging.

gap.claim: Backtesting is costly and parameter-sensitive, correlation metrics omit important alpha properties, and closed-source models hinder reproducibility.

contributions.claim: AlphaEval is a unified, parallelizable, backtest-free framework for evaluating automated alpha mining models.
The framework evaluates generated alphas across predictive power, stability, robustness to market perturbations, financial logic, and diversity.
The implementations and evaluation tools are open-sourced.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Across representative alpha mining algorithms, AlphaEval reportedly achieves evaluation consistency comparable to comprehensive backtesting while providing broader insights and higher efficiency.
AlphaEval reportedly identifies superior alphas more effectively than traditional single-metric screening approaches.

narrative_sequence.summary: Formula alpha mining generates predictive financial signals and is important for quantitative investment.
Expanded alpha-discovery methods have made systematic evaluation a key challenge.
Existing backtesting and correlation-based metrics are costly or incomplete, while closed-source models hinder reproducibility.
AlphaEval provides unified, parallelizable, backtest-free evaluation across five complementary dimensions.
The authors report comparable consistency to comprehensive backtesting, higher efficiency, improved alpha identification, and open-sourced tooling.

source_observation.claim: Evaluation based only on predictive ability can overlook stability, robustness, diversity, and interpretability.

interpretation.claim: Evaluation frameworks for generated artifacts may need multiple complementary quality dimensions.

application.claim: When screening automatically generated candidates, combine performance measures with stability, robustness, diversity, and interpretability checks.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish that these dimensions are sufficient for every alpha-mining setting.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the individual metrics or procedures used for the five evaluation dimensions.
The abstract does not provide datasets, algorithm names, numerical results, or experimental settings.
The abstract does not establish the scope or maintenance status of the open-source release.
